budget._note: Physics time allowed per drawn frame (ms) and per car per physics step (ms). The debug HUD shows the cost against these, and the test suite fails if a car costs more than carStepMs, so there's room for many cars (traffic, multiplayer).

impacts._note: Crashes (physics/impacts.js): the car body touching anything counts as an impact from minSpeed m/s into it (groundMinSpeed for what's under the car: a hard landing, not the floor pan brushing the road), measured over window s from the first touch; while it stays in contact, a sudden push of more than spike m/s is a new impact (at most every cooldown s). Sliding along something faster than scrapeSpeed m/s, pressed on with more than scrapeForce N, is a scrape.

debris._note: Loose and torn-off parts (physics/looseParts.js). At most max pieces lie about (the oldest go first), none further than maxDistance m from the car or older than maxAge s; a piece settled on the ground sleeps. Torn off, a piece passes through the car it came from for ignoreCarFor s (no jitter). A part body weighs at least minMass kg (joints stay steady against the car); loose, it swings with hingeFriction and angularDamping, the air pushing on it as a flat plate (plate × dynamic pressure). A piece that changes speed by more than clatterFrom m/s in a step has hit something (a clatter, at most every clatterEvery s).
